description: This file provides numerical integration functions (Euler and RK4) for updating 2D state variables (x, y) based on their derivatives. It's used for simulating dynamics within a game or physics engine.

methods.name: integrateEuler(state, deriv, dt)
methods.description: Performs simple Euler integration to update 2D state variables using provided derivatives and timestep.

methods.name: integrateRK4(state, deriv, dt)
methods.description: Performs classical 4th order Runge-Kutta (RK4) integration to update 2D state variables using provided derivatives and timestep.
